product.olivetti-pcs44.summary: The PCS 44 shared the BA362 platform with the M300-28.
product.olivetti-pcs44.history: L’Unità documented the PCS 44 in September 1992 among Olivetti’s new 486SX compatibles. The service guide grouped it with the M300-28.
product.olivetti-pcs44.architecture: Graphics were integrated on the motherboard. The guide lists OTI-077, National 87C311 and V032004K.25 Flash BIOS for the BA362.
product.olivetti-pcs44.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-pcs44.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-pcs44.guide: Olivetti, Pocket Service Guide, vol. I, §35.
